purpose: Give a fact as the basis for an inference or name.
keywords: Plain form + ことから; noun / な-adjective + であることから
The wet road tells us that it has rained.
It received this name because its shape resembles a star.
This venue was chosen because it is close to the station.
formation: Plain form + ことから; noun / な-adjective + であることから
restrictions: The first clause provides evidence or the basis for the conclusion.
mistake: It need not describe a direct physical cause.
